app.lema: Your jobs up to date, from your phone.

inicio.pronto: Your week, your jobs and the end-of-day report will show up here.
inicio.salirAyuda: Next time it will ask for your PIN.
inicio.gastosPorRevisar: {n, plural, one {# purchase to review} other {# purchases to review}}
inicio.avisosPorContestar: {n, plural, one {# alert to answer} other {# alerts to answer}}

sinAcceso.texto: To get in, ask the owner for an invitation and open it on this phone.
sinAcceso.baja: If you used to sign in here, this phone may have been removed or your access turned off.

invitacion.texto: When you continue, this phone gets verified and you choose your PIN. Open it only on your own phone.
invitacion.invalidaTexto: It may have been used, expired (they last 7 days) or been canceled. Ask the owner for a new one.
invitacion.yaTieneDueno: This phone already has access as {nombre}. A phone belongs to one person only: if you continue, {nombre} will no longer be able to sign in here and will need a new invitation. If this is someone else, open it on their own phone.

pin.nuevoTexto: {largo} digits. You'll use it every day to sign in on this phone.
pin.olvide: Forgot your PIN? Ask the owner for a new invitation.

equipo.enlaceTexto: Send this link by WhatsApp, text or email. It works once, for 7 days, and must be opened on their own phone.

errores.solo_dueno: Only the owner can do this.
errores.correo_ya_registrado: That email already belongs to a member.
errores.miembro_no_activo: That member's access is turned off.
errores.miembro_invalido: That change can't be made to this member.
errores.dispositivo_invalido: This phone no longer has access.
errores.pin_invalido: The PIN has {largo} digits, numbers only.
errores.pin_debil: That PIN is too easy to guess: don't repeat one number or use a run like 1234.
errores.pin_ya_fijado: This phone already has a PIN.
errores.pin_quedan: {quedan, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
errores.pin_bloqueado: Too many tries. Try again at {hora}.
errores.telefono_incompleto: The phone needs at least 10 digits.
errores.entrega_antes_del_inicio: Delivery can't be before the start.
errores.etapa_no_es_del_espacio: That stage doesn't belong to that space.
errores.obra_cerrada: The job was delivered: its budget doesn't change.
errores.tipo_espacio_inexistente: That space type no longer exists.
errores.falta_tipo_generales: The catalog is missing General conditions.
errores.solo_pm: Only the job's PM closes the day.
errores.fuera_de_ventana: That day can no longer be closed here: ask the owner to record it.
errores.partida_de_otra_obra: A line item is not from this job.
errores.terminada_sin_trabajar: To mark a line item finished, also mark it as worked on.
errores.falta_motivo_sin_trabajo: Choose why there was no work.
errores.obra_sin_presupuesto: The job has no budget yet: the owner has to enter it before starting.
errores.falta_foto: Take at least one photo of the day.
errores.faltan_partidas: Check at least one line item worked on.
errores.orden_de_otra_obra: A work order is not from this job.
errores.falta_inspeccion: A line item can't be finished without its approved inspection.
errores.cuadrilla_dia_o_medio: Someone paid by the day gets a full or half day.
errores.cuadrilla_pasa_un_dia: That worker already has a full day recorded across your jobs.
errores.cuadrilla_pasa_16_horas: That worker would go over 16 hours in the day.
errores.cuadrilla_sin_partida: To record the crew, check at least one line item worked on.
errores.foto_no_comprometida: That photo doesn't belong to this close.
errores.correccion_sin_senal: Correcting a close needs signal. Try again when you have it.
errores.sesion_vencida: Your session expired: enter your PIN and try again.
errores.fuera_de_48_horas: More than 48 hours have passed: ask the owner.
errores.tipo_sin_nombre: Enter the name of the job type.
errores.tipo_repetido: A job type with that name already exists (it may be deactivated).
errores.tipo_sin_partidas: Enter at least one line item, one per line.
errores.tipo_generales: General conditions cannot be deactivated: every job has it.
errores.partida_sin_nombre: Enter the name of the line item.
errores.partida_repetida: That type already has a line item with that name.
errores.partida_inexistente: That line item no longer exists.
errores.etapa_sin_nombre: Enter the name of the stage.
errores.etapa_repetida: A stage with that name already exists.
errores.inspeccion_sin_foto: The inspection needs photos: they are the only evidence that will remain.
errores.hito_sin_preguntas: This checkpoint has no questions. Ask the owner to add them.
errores.ninguno_aplica: An inspection needs at least one question that applies.
errores.falta_prueba_agua: Waterproofing can't be approved without a finished flood test with no leaks in this space.
errores.prueba_sin_foto: Take the photo of the water level.
errores.prueba_en_curso: There is already a flood test in progress in this space.
errores.prueba_incompleta: It's been {horas} hours. The test lasts 24: closing it early proves nothing; let it run and come back.
errores.prueba_no_encontrada: That test is no longer in progress.
errores.espacio_no_encontrado: That space doesn't belong to this job.
errores.aviso_sin_detalle: Describe the problem in detail so the owner can solve it.
errores.respuesta_corta: Write a useful answer for the PM.

obraNueva.sinPms: There are no active PMs: invite one in Team before creating the job.
obraNueva.espaciosAyuda: General conditions is added automatically. Each space gets the line items of its type.
obraNueva.partidas: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
obraNueva.duplicada: This client already has an active job at that address. Is this a different job?

presupuesto.ayuda: The amount for each stage of each space. Every space needs at least one stage with an amount before the job can start.
presupuesto.partidas: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
presupuesto.completo: Budget complete: the job is ready to start.

inicioPm.racha: {n, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day in a row closed} other {# days in a row closed}}
inicioPm.sinObras: You have no jobs assigned. When the owner assigns you one, it shows up here.
inicioPm.faltoCerrar: You missed closing {dia} on {obra}. You can still close it.
inicioPm.tarde: {n, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
inicioPm.cambioDias: {n, plural, =0 {no extra days} one {+# day} other {+# days}}

cierre.partidasAyuda: Check the line items of the day; if one is finished, mark it done.
cierre.faltaInspeccion: To finish it, first the {hito} inspection.
cierre.sinPartidas: There are no line items left on this job.
cierre.cuadrilla: Who from the crew was there?
cierre.fotosAyuda: At least one. They upload after you close.
cierre.nFotos: {n, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}
cierre.guardadoSinRed: No signal: the close was saved on the phone and will send itself when there is signal.
cierre.guardadoSinSesion: The close was saved on the phone. Enter your PIN to send it.
cierre.fotosEsperan: {n, plural, one {# photo is waiting for signal; it will upload by itself.} other {# photos are waiting for signal; they will upload by themselves.}}
cierre.yaNoSeCorrige: More than 48 hours have passed: ask the owner to correct it.
cierre.fotosGuardadas: {n, plural, one {# photo already saved; it stays with the close.} other {# photos already saved; they stay with the close.}}
cierre.porQue: What did you correct? (it stays on record)

cola.pendientes: {n, plural, one {# record waiting to send} other {# records waiting to send}} from this phone (closes, expenses, alerts and their photos).
cola.sinRed: No signal right now: it will send itself when it's back.
cola.cierreRechazado: The {obra} close for {dia} was not saved:
cola.fotoRechazada: A photo from the {obra} close for {dia} was not saved:
cola.gastoRechazado: An expense for {obra} on {dia} was not saved:
cola.avisoRechazado: An alert for {obra} on {dia} was not saved:

catalogo.ayuda: Job types and their line items. Each new space copies its type's line items; existing jobs don't change.
catalogo.partidas: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
catalogo.enBlancoAyuda: For work unlike what you already have: a concrete floor, drywall and paint.
catalogo.copiarAyuda: Copy another type's line items and edit them. Faster than starting from scratch.
catalogo.partidasEjemplo:
Protection and prep
Crack repair
Grinding and polishing
Sealer
catalogo.tamanoAyuda: Sets how much this type weighs in the progress of a combined job: a full bathroom adds up to 90 and a closet 30. It is split evenly among the line items; you can fine-tune each one later.
catalogo.etapasAyuda: The budget is entered by stage. A line item without a stage falls under "Other line items".
catalogo.tipoAyuda: What you change here applies to new spaces; existing jobs keep their line items.
catalogo.tipoDeBaja: This type is deactivated: it is not offered for new jobs.
catalogo.resumen: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}} · total weight {peso}
catalogo.paraleloCampo: Runs at the same time as the previous one
catalogo.esperaCampo: Days of waiting before it starts
catalogo.esperaAyuda: For fabrication or drying: the schedule pushes it back that many workdays.
catalogo.darDeBajaAyuda: It won't be offered for new jobs; jobs that use it don't change.

sinSenal.sinCopia: To use the app without signal, open it once with signal and enter your PIN: that saves your jobs on this phone.
sinSenal.pinAyuda: Enter your PIN to open what this phone saved of your jobs.
sinSenal.aviso: You have no signal. You're working with what was saved {cuando}; whatever you close will send itself when it's back.
sinSenal.sinObras: You had no jobs assigned the last time there was signal.
sinSenal.enElTelefono: You already closed today: it is on the phone and will send when there is signal.

fotos.n: {n, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}

calidad.sinPuntos: This job's line items have no checkpoints.
calidad.ayudaInspeccion: Check what passes. If a question doesn't apply on this job, tap N/A. Anything left unchecked is recorded as a defect.
calidad.sinPreguntas: This checkpoint has no questions. Ask the owner to add them.
calidad.fotosAyuda: Each full wall, with a tape measure where it helps. At least one.
calidad.ningunoAplica: An inspection needs at least one question that applies.
calidad.confirmarDefectos: {n, plural, one {# item not passing} other {# items not passing}}. It is recorded as a defect. Save anyway?
calidad.guardando: Sending {n, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}…
calidad.guardadaConDefectos: Inspection saved with {n, plural, one {# defect} other {# defects}}. The line item can't be finished until it's approved.
calidad.pruebaVuelve: Come back when the 24 hours are up. Closing it early proves nothing.
calidad.fotoNivelInicio: Photo of the level when filled
calidad.hayFuga: The level dropped: there is a leak
calidad.confirmarFuga: Record a leak? Waterproofing won't be approved.
calidad.ultimaConFuga: The last test found a leak.
calidad.pruebaComo: Plug the drain, fill the wet area and take the photo of the level. Come back in 24 hours with another photo.

gasto.ayuda: Always with the company card. Record it in the parking lot, not at night. Limit without approval: {limite}.
gasto.sinPartida: — No line item (goes to General conditions) —
gasto.enRevision: Expense recorded. It is over the {limite} limit: the owner can already see it to review.
gasto.guardadoSinRed: No signal: the expense was saved on the phone and will send itself when there is signal.
gasto.guardadoSinSesion: The expense was saved on the phone. Enter your PIN to send it.
gasto.tusGastosAyuda: The ones without a receipt, and what you recorded in the last 48 hours: you can correct or void it. Nothing is deleted: the record of what you changed and why stays.
gasto.pendienteRevision: Over your limit: the owner will review it.
gasto.anularAyuda: The expense stays recorded, but it is left out of all calculations.

revisionGastos.ayuda: Your PMs' purchases that went over their limit. Review them and mark them reviewed.
revisionGastos.ninguno: There are no purchases to review.

aviso.ayuda: If something stops the work, raise it with a photo. Response commitment: {horas} hours.
aviso.descripcion: What is happening and what you need
aviso.descripcionEjemplo: Behind the wall there is a corroded galvanized steel line. I need to know whether to replace it before closing the wall.
aviso.enviado: Alert sent. The owner commits to answer within {horas} hours.
aviso.guardadoSinRed: No signal: the alert was saved on the phone and will send itself when there is signal.
aviso.guardadoSinSesion: The alert was saved on the phone. Enter your PIN to send it.

avisosAbiertos.horasFuera: Since {cuando} · {horas} h: past the response commitment
avisosAbiertos.detiene: Stops the work: people are idle
avisosAbiertos.respuestaEjemplo: Yes, replace it before closing. I already ordered the material; it arrives tomorrow.
